title: Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed
abstract: arXiv:2610.01674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). translated_title: 发明数据集：衡量零种子条件下的数据集生成能力
translated_abstract: 构建数据集仍然是AI开发中最依赖人工且最脆弱的环节之一。在本技术报告中，我们关注现实世界从业者面临的最极端但也最普遍的场景：零数据条件。在这种情况下，从业者对于他们想要训练的能力完全没有任何数据。我们提出了Invent-A-Dataset，这是一个基于提示词的系统，可以从数据集描述出发生成真实且大规模的后训练数据集。我们在包括Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Zai在内的五个前沿模型API上对Invent-A-Dataset进行了评估。在八种任务类型以及高达2万样本的数据集规模上，Invent-A-Dataset显著超越了对手，同时实现了最高质量（相对提升17%）和最多样的样本（相对提升19%）。其多样性优势随着训练数据集规模的扩大而进一步拉大（从200个样本时的持平到2万样本时37%的相对提升）。
tldr: Invent-A-Dataset是一个基于提示词的系统，能在零数据条件下从数据集描述生成高质量、大规模的后训练数据集，相比五个前沿模型API实现17%的质量提升和19%的多样性提升，且数据规模越大优势越明显。
en_tdlr: Invent-A-Dataset is a prompt-based system that generates high-quality, large-scale post-training datasets from dataset descriptions in zero-data regimes, outperforming five frontier model APIs with 17% relative quality gains and 19% diversity gains, with its diversity advantage widening as dataset scale increases.
